messages:
Sasha: quick check — we're targeting 21:00 UTC for the canary push tonight. who is the primary deployer?
Liam: I can do the deploy. will be available 20:45-22:15 UTC.
Jamie: I'll own smoke and logs for the first 15m after canary. have the dashboards up. :eyes:
Maria: I'll be oncall for broader incidents and can flip capacity toggles if needed.
Sasha: thanks. big ask: confirm undo/abort points + exact commands to revert canary to previous model variant. paste runbook snippets if possible.
Liam: undo plan high-level: 1) pause traffic to canary 2) revert routing -> previous model 3) scale down canary pods 4) monitor error rate for 5m
Jamie: smoke checklist I'll run: latency P95, token error rate, tail-kps, quota spikes. passing = P95 < 200ms and error rate < 0.5% for 5m.
Maria: oncall checklist: alerts to watch: infra-high-latency, model-deploy-errors, autoscaler-failures. I can mute noisier alerts during window but will keep critical ones.
Liam: actual revert commands (dev cluster example):
```
# switch route back to stable
kubectl -n inference set image svc/model-router router=image-registry/stable:20260203
# scale down canary
kubectl -n inference scale deployment model-canary --replicas=0
# verify rollout status
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment model-router -w
```
Sasha: perfect. add: if rollout status hangs > 3m, escalate to Maria and run the emergency detach: `deployctl detach-canary --force`
DeployBot: NOTE: scheduled deploy window 2026-03-17T21:00:00Z. auto-backup snapshot created: snap-20260317-2100 (read-only).
Jamie: quick Q — are we using KV cache reset on canary? that can mask regressions.
Liam: not resetting cache for this canary; we'll use a small traffic fraction (5%) to surface regressions.
Maria: rollback criteria we agreed on: 1) sustained error rate > 0.5% for 3m, OR 2) P95 increase > 2x baseline for 5m, OR 3) infra alerts triggered (autoscaler/oom/kube crashloop).
Sasha: add one more: if user-facing quality regressions from eval suite fail (prompt set A) with >10% regressions in hits -> abort.
Jamie: where's the eval runbook link?
Sasha: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/undo-scenarios and https://redwood-dashboard/evals/canary-20260317 (public to the team).
Oncall Eng: I'll be reachable on pager and my phone. Ping me with `@Oncall Eng` if we need immediate detach.
Liam: final preflight checklist (local):
- confirm snapshots ✅
- canary config validated (5% traffic) ✅
- revert commands staged in notes ✅
- owners: deploy=Liam, smoke=Jamie, oncall=Maria ✅
Sasha: go/no-go timeline: 20:50 UTC final sanity. if no objections by 20:55, proceed with canary at 21:00.
Jamie: I'll post short results in this thread at +5m and +15m after canary.
Maria: I'll standby for any escalation, and will flip capacity toggles if backend saturates.
Liam: understood. will post `starting canary` and `canary complete` messages.
Sasha: thanks team. leaving the runbook pinned in the channel. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: Deploy event created: evt-1928427600. Rollback token: rbk-7c9f (use with `deployctl rollback rbk-7c9f`).
